segments.text: The Alaskan Good Friday earthquake, which has been considered to be the largest one in
segments.englishExplanation: Introduces the earthquake as the largest recorded in North America.

segments.text: Waves reached towns along the coast within minutes, and some of them were destroyed.
segments.englishExplanation: Describes how the tsunami waves reached coastal towns quickly and destroyed some.

segments.text: Scientists learned a lot from this disaster.
segments.englishExplanation: States that researchers gained important scientific knowledge from studying the disaster.

segments.text: Today, warning systems help coastal towns get ready before the water arrives.
segments.englishExplanation: Notes how modern alert systems prepare coastal towns for incoming tsunamis.
segments.turkishExplanation: Günümüzde uyarı sistemleri, kıyı kasabalarının su ulaşmadan önce hazırlanmasına yardımcı oluyor.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To cause a particular event or situation to happen as a consequence.
